title.zh: 调制 · 把信号搬上载波
title.en: Modulation · carrying a signal on a carrier

description.zh: 把低频的声音乘上一个高频载波，整段频谱就搬到载波两侧，既能用尺寸合适的天线发得远，又能让许多电台各占一段频率；调幅（AM）改变载波的幅度，调频（FM）改变它的瞬时频率，接收端再把频谱搬回来。
description.en: Multiplying a low-frequency signal by a high-frequency carrier moves its whole spectrum up beside the carrier, so it can travel far from a reasonably sized antenna and many stations can share the air on separate bands; AM varies the carrier’s amplitude, FM its instantaneous frequency, and the receiver moves the spectrum back down.

aliases.zh: AM 和 FM 的区别

aliases.en: how does a radio tune in one station

reason.zh: 频谱列出信号含有哪些频率；乘上 cos(2πf_c t) 后每个分量都分裂成 f_c ± f 两份，整张成分表被平移到载波两侧，形状不变。
reason.en: A spectrum lists which frequencies a signal contains; multiplying by cos(2πf_c t) splits every component into f_c ± f, shifting the whole list to either side of the carrier with its shape intact.

label.zh: 积化和差产生两条边带

reason.zh: cos A·cos B = ½[cos(A − B) + cos(A + B)]：一个 10 Hz 的消息乘上载波，就变成载波上下各一条、幅度为 m/2 的边带。
reason.en: cos A·cos B = ½[cos(A − B) + cos(A + B)]: a 10 Hz message multiplied by the carrier becomes two sidebands, one above and one below the carrier, each of amplitude m/2.

label.zh: 采样也是一次乘法搬家

reason.zh: 采样相当于乘上一串等间隔的脉冲，频谱被复制到采样率的整数倍处；采样率不够时副本相互重叠就是混叠，和邻台频谱蹭进带通造成串扰一样，都是频谱重叠。
reason.en: Sampling multiplies by a train of evenly spaced pulses, copying the spectrum to every multiple of the sampling rate; too low a rate makes the copies overlap — aliasing, which like crosstalk from a neighbouring station is a case of overlapping spectra.

question.zh: 收音机是怎么从一堆电台里只听到一个的？
question.en: How does a radio pick out one station from so many?

ask.zh: 几家电台把各自的声音搬到哪里？接收端怎样把想听的那家搬回来？
ask.en: Where does each station move its audio, and how does the receiver bring back just the one it wants?

ask.zh: 在频谱上，不同电台是靠什么分开的？靠得太近会怎样？
ask.en: On the spectrum, what keeps stations apart, and what happens if they get too close?

reveal.zh: 每家电台用不同的载波频率把声音搬到频谱上各自的一段；收音机用带通滤波圈住目标那一段，再乘上同频载波把它搬回基带。相邻电台的频段一旦重叠进带通，就会串台。
reveal.en: Each station uses its own carrier to move its audio into its own slice of the spectrum; the radio fences off the target slice with a band-pass filter and multiplies by a matching carrier to bring it back to baseband. If a neighbour’s band overlaps the pass band, you hear crosstalk.
